Verdict: label agreement between LoRA screening and the merged GGUFs is 97–98.5%, against 98–99.5% run-to-run, and accuracy is within ±3 rows of 200. That is good enough for screening, not for gate decisions: the winner still gets the merged Q4_0 build plus the 1,148-row test. On these rows v2 and mixA50 differ by less than the run-to-run noise (99% same status), so the mixes sit at the noise floor.
